name: Waqt: Prayer Times
description: Islamic prayer times in Orca's status bar: the next prayer, a countdown and desktop reminders. Calculated offline (Kemenag, JAKIM, MUIS, MWL, ISNA, Umm al-Qura and more), no internet needed. Bahasa Indonesia and English.

settings.title: Language
settings.description: Language of the status bar, panel and notifications.

settings.title: City
settings.description: Automatic guesses from your computer's time zone, anywhere in the world. For more accurate times, search for your city in the Prayer Times panel, choose one here, or choose Other to use the latitude and longitude below.
enumLabels: Picked in the Prayer Times panel

settings.title: City from the panel
settings.description: Set by the city search in the Prayer Times panel (a time zone city such as Europe/London). Used when City is "Picked in the Prayer Times panel".

settings.title: Latitude
settings.description: Used only when City is Other. South is negative, for example -6.2.

settings.title: Longitude
settings.description: Used only when City is Other. West is negative, for example -0.12.

settings.title: Calculation method
settings.description: Automatic uses Kemenag in Indonesia, JAKIM in Malaysia, MUIS in Singapore, Umm al-Qura in Saudi Arabia, the Egyptian authority in Egypt, ISNA in the US and Canada, and the Muslim World League elsewhere.

settings.title: Hijri date adjustment (days)
settings.description: Shifts the Umm al-Qura calendar to match your country's moon sighting (in Indonesia, the isbat). Also decides when Ramadan starts for the imsak reminder.

settings.title: Safety margin (ihtiyat, minutes)
settings.description: Minutes added to each time for safety. Automatic follows the calculation method.
enumLabels: Automatic (the method's own: 2 for Kemenag, JAKIM and MUIS, 0 otherwise)

settings.title: Notify when a prayer time begins
Notify for Fajr (Subuh)
settings.description: Turn off a prayer to skip both its early reminder and the notification when it begins.

settings.title: Remind before sunrise (minutes)
settings.description: Fajr ends at sunrise. 0 turns this reminder off.

settings.title: Jumu'ah reminder (minutes before)
settings.description: On Fridays this replaces the regular Dhuhr reminder, so there is time to get to the mosque. 0 turns it off.

settings.title: Show my agents
settings.description: Uses your Orca workspaces' agent status: reminders before a prayer mention agents still working or waiting for your approval, the status bar turns red when a prayer is close and an agent is waiting, the panel lists them so you can open one, and 20 minutes after a prayer begins a note says what your agents did meanwhile.

settings.title: Imsak reminder
settings.description: Imsak is 10 minutes before Fajr. Ramadan follows the Hijri date, including the adjustment above.

settings.title: Remind at Duha time
settings.description: When the sun is 4.5° up, as Kemenag reckons it.

settings.title: Remind the evening before a sunnah fast
settings.description: An hour after Isha before Mondays, Thursdays, the White Days (13 to 15 of each Hijri month), Arafah, Tasu'a and Ashura. Skipped in Ramadan and on days when fasting is not allowed.
